options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one production-quality mobile app launch/loading screen concept for the existing Sobrita personal-budget companion app. Direction name: "Michi, a quiet hello". This is a single flat app screen, not a presentation or collage. Target viewport 390 x 844, portrait aspect ratio 390:844; render crisply at high resolution.
Grounding: attached first image is the actual Michi mascot identity, attached second image is an existing Sobrita design reference for pixel typography, cream/navy/teal palette. Use these as references, not as a screen to replicate. Character identity must stay faithful: dark navy cat, one upright ear and one folded ear, three cream forehead stripes, huge amber eyes, cream muzzle/chest/paws/tail tip, teal collar, square gold charm. Pixel art, no vector flattening.
Design: exceptionally quiet minimal launch screen with full-bleed warm cream #F6EFE0 background, flat clean color with almost no texture. Generous whitespace. A compact central cluster: faithfully drawn sitting Michi mascot around 112 logical pixels tall centered at y 315, tiny restrained pixel ground shadow; directly below him the exact word "Sobrita" in large 38px navy #202848 Pixelify Sans-style blocky pixel lettering, readable and charming. Keep the mascot modest in scale, not poster-sized. Beneath wordmark generous 30px gap and three small square loading dots, one teal #0E7A72 and two pale beige #E7DDC8. Near lower center at y 710, exact Korean status "잠시만 기다려 주세요" in quiet readable 14px dark muted #545E7E Korean pixel typography. No other text.
Clear hierarchy, purposeful spacing, restrained premium game-inspired warmth. This is a passive launch screen, therefore no action buttons, no navigation, no cards, no metrics, no financial values or percent progress, no decorations unrelated to the mascot. App content only: no device bezel, notch, status bar, clock, battery, home indicator, rounded phone corners, browser chrome or device shadow. Do not include a concept name or option number in the image. No multiple panels. Preserve natural aspect ratio.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one production-quality mobile app launch/loading screen concept for existing Sobrita personal-budget companion app. Direction name: "A little home waiting for you". This is one flat app screen, not a presentation or collage. Target viewport 390 x 844 logical pixels, portrait aspect ratio 390:844; render at high resolution.
Grounding: attached first image defines the actual Michi mascot. Attached second existing Sobrita design reference grounds the pixel lettering, warm cream walls, teal curtains, honey-colored wooden floor and cozy room. Preserve the brand style, but make a completely new launch screen. Faithful Michi: navy kitten, one upright ear and one folded ear, three cream forehead stripes, large amber eyes, cream muzzle/chest/paws/tail tip, teal collar with square golden charm.
Design: an immersive full-bleed pixel-art room scene, carefully sparse, like arriving home. Upper 36 percent is generous quiet warm cream wall #F6EFE0. At y 132 centered exact word "Sobrita" in large readable dark navy #202848 Pixelify Sans-style pixel lettering. Beneath wordmark exact Korean line "나의 작은 일상을 준비해요" in 15px dark muted readable Korean pixel typography. The bottom two-thirds is a cozy sunlit room continuous with that cream wall, no enclosing card or panel. A single compact window centered slightly right at mid-height, green-teal curtains, pale blue sky, soft morning light. Warm wooden floor spans lower 25 percent. A small faithful Michi sits slightly left of center at y 630 on a pale lavender woven rug, looking expectantly toward the viewer. One small plant in a terracotta pot to far right, no additional furniture. Cat small and naturally scaled to room; environment leads the composition.
At y 745, placed clearly on a very calm area of floor, a tiny centered row of five pixel squares, first three teal #0E7A72 and other two muted cream, functioning as an indeterminate loading motif; beneath exact status "불러오는 중…" in dark navy 14px readable typography. No percentages. Polished purposeful spacing and strong legibility, pixel-art edges with consistent grid and restrained shading, inviting mood, avoid visual clutter. Typography must be crisp against plain background.
App content only. No phone bezel, body, notch, clock, status icons, battery, home indicator, rounded device frame, device shadow or browser. No navigation, buttons, cards, financial metrics or promotional copy. Do not print direction name or option number. One screen only, natural proportions.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one production-quality mobile startup/loading screen for existing Sobrita personal-budget companion app. Direction name: "Little coins, growing together". ONE standalone flat app screen, no presentation, no collage. Target viewport 390 x 844 logical pixels, portrait aspect 390:844, high-resolution crisp rendering.
Attached first reference is the actual Michi mascot identity; attached second is existing Sobrita product design for pixel typography and palette and savings-jar motifs. Use as brand grounding, not a screenshot to copy. Preserve Michi: navy kitten, one upright ear and one folded ear, three cream forehead stripes, amber eyes, cream muzzle/chest/paws/tail tip, teal collar with square golden charm. Coherent pixel art, preserve mascot proportions.
Visual idea and hierarchy: a playful but beautifully restrained savings-themed splash with a very pale mint #D8EDEA full-bleed background instead of cream. Large clean negative space at top 24 percent. Near x 36 y 205, place exact word "Sobrita" left-aligned in 38px bold dark navy #202848 Pixelify Sans-style pixel lettering. Under it exact Korean tagline on two lines: "작은 기록이" and "차곡차곡 쌓여요" in 23px readable dark navy pixel Hangul. Space the title and illustration generously.
Main illustration in lower middle: a big beautiful squat transparent glass savings jar with a few gold coins inside, teal glass highlights and a warm cream paper label bearing a simple pixel paw (no text). Jar at center-left x 145 y 465; on its right, smaller faithful Michi stands on hind paws holding one gold coin just above the jar opening, clearly about to drop it in. Cat and jar interact naturally, both feet supported on the same minimal baseline. Only two restrained small gold pixel sparkles near the falling coin. No room environment, no additional props, no decorative UI cards. The entire illustration has carefully crafted old-school pixel edges, rich restrained shading, not 3D or smooth vector.
At lower y 710, put a simple continuous thin navy-outlined horizontal loading track approximately 150px wide, with a short teal segment in the middle suggesting indeterminate motion; no percentage numbers, no fabricated timing. Below it exact Korean status "불러오는 중…" in clear 14px navy text. All text readable and correctly spelled, no other wording.
Use purposeful spacing, natural scale, visual warmth. No device frame, bezel, rounded corners, OS status bar, time, battery, notch, home indicator, browser chrome or device shadow. Passive launch screen: no action buttons or navigation, no cards, no account amounts, no dashboard, no concept title or option number. One screen only.
